title: Up And Over
style: synth pop, 118 BPM, retro 80s lead synth, gated reverb drums, female vocal, soaring chorus, cinematic build, hopeful, joyful
lyrics:
[Intro]
Up and over, up and over
Watch the ball arc to the back of the line

[Verse 1]
They were stacked at the kitchen, paddles up high
Nobody guarding the open sky
I took a soft scoop with a backhand wrist
And the ball found a window they couldn't resist

[Pre-Chorus]
Find the gap in the picture
Find the air above the head
Find the soft moment
Where the angle isn't dead

[Chorus]
Up and over, up and over
Arcs of grace from the white-tape clover
Up and over, up and over
Land it deep, the rally's done over
Up and over

[Verse 2]
They turned around like a slow parade
Laughing at the rainbow that the paddle made
Good shot, good shot, the four of us laughed
The friendliest weapon in the friendliest craft

[Pre-Chorus]
Find the gap in the picture
Find the air above the head
Find the soft moment
Where the angle isn't dead

[Chorus]
Up and over, up and over
Arcs of grace from the white-tape clover
Up and over, up and over
Land it deep, the rally's done over
Up and over

[Bridge]
A gentle weapon
A polite surprise
A rainbow drawn
With a wrist of flies

[Outro]
Up and over
Up and over
Up and over (rally's done)
